input.question: When was the Empire of Haiti established?

documents.text: Second Empire of Haiti The Second Haitian Empire, officially known as the Empire of Haiti (French: "Empire d'Haïti"; Haitian Creole: "Anpi an Ayiti"), was a state which existed from 1849 to 1859. It was established by the then-President, former Lieutenant General and Supreme Commander of the Presidential Guards under President Riché, Faustin Soulouque, who, inspired by Napoleon I, declared himself Emperor Faustin I of Haiti on August 26, 1849 at the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Assumption in Port-au-Prince.
